desc: Read the number of test cases $T$.
For each test case, read $R$ and $B$.
Check if $R$ is odd. If so, print "No".
If $R$ is even, construct a valid sequence.

Implement the solution: Read $T$, loop through test cases. If $R$ is odd, print "No". If $R$ is even, construct the sequence using the pattern: $(1,1) \to (1,2) \to (2,1) \to (2,2) \to (1,3) \to (1,4) \to (2,3) \to (2,4) \dots$ assigning types based on the move type required (Red for odd steps, Blue for even steps) and handling the wrap-around for the cycle closure.
